result.summary: The page is largely clean with no clear layout breakage. The main concern is a logic mismatch: the Pizza filter is active, but the listings shown are Poké, Burgers, and Ramen. Secondary gray text also has low contrast. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were excluded per the instructions.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is selected, yet the 'Fastest near you' and 'Popular right now' sections show non-pizza restaurants (Green Bowl Poké, Smash Bros Burgers, Tokumaru Ramen Bar). The filter state and the displayed content are inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Filter the restaurant sections by the selected category, or reset the chip selection to 'All' when the content is not filtered, so the UI state matches the results shown.

issues.description: Secondary gray text, such as the delivery fees (e.g., '€0.90 delivery'), the 'DELIVER TO' label, and the rating count '(500+)', appears light gray on white and may fall below recommended WCAG contrast ratios for small text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the white background.
